In this experiment, confusion matrix graphs are drawn to

types of faults under a noise environment of −8 dB. Figure 17

and RegNet, two lightweight networks, have misdiagnosis

When collecting fault signals, the signals we gather are
often mixed with noise, which can be complex and variable.
Therefore, simulating only a constant noise environment is

FPN and other comparative models under a dynamically chan-
ging noise environment, we set a noise dynamic range with a
